        .text
        .type   impl_a,@function
impl_a: movl    $1, %eax
        ret
        .globl  pick
        .type   pick,@gnu_indirect_function
pick:   leaq    impl_a(%rip), %rax
        ret
        .globl  use_pick
        .type   use_pick,@function
use_pick:
        jmp     pick@PLT
        .section .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits
